There may be a lot of heat here, but not all heat is intimacy. Sometimes the charge comes from being challenged. Sometimes it comes from feeling provoked. The trick is knowing the difference between passion and a pattern that keeps making you tense.

Failure mode: confusing friction for chemistry and staying because the conflict makes the connection feel alive.

Use the charge for something you're building together. Don't keep turning it on each other.
